drivingQuestion: What is the aorta, and how much of it must be perforated for the animal to be a tereifa?
outcomeNote: Abaye's answer to R' Zeira is rejected and nothing replaces it; the Rav–Shmuel dispute over the aorta is left standing, with Shmuel merely deriding Rav's view.

segments.he: הָכִי הַשְׁתָּא? הָתָם לְבֵית הַסִּמְפּוֹנוֹת קָתָנֵי, לְהֵיכָא דְּשָׁפְכִי סִמְפּוֹנוֹת כּוּלְּהוּ, וְהָכָא לְבֵית חֲלָלוֹ קָתָנֵי – מָה לִי חָלָל גָּדוֹל, מָה לִי חָלָל קָטָן!
segments.en: The Gemara responds: «How can» these cases «be compared? There,» the mishna «teaches: To the bronchi [simponot],» in the plural form, i.e., the one bronchus «into which all the bronchi [simponot] empty» out. «But here,» with regard to the heart, it «teaches: To the chamber. What» is it «to me» if this is «a large chamber» and «what» is it «to me» if it is «a small chamber?» The language does not indicate one or the other.

segments.he: קְנֵה הַלֵּב, רַב אָמַר: בְּמַשֶּׁהוּ, וּשְׁמוּאֵל אָמַר: בְּרוּבּוֹ.
segments.en: § With regard to the «aorta,» the chief artery exiting the heart, «Rav says:» Like the heart itself, if it is perforated «in any amount» the animal is a tereifa. «And Shmuel says:» The animal is a tereifa only if the aorta is perforated «in its majority.»

segments.he: הֵי נִיהוּ קְנֵה הַלֵּב? אָמַר רַבָּה בַּר יִצְחָק אָמַר רַב: חֵלֶב שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי דְּפָנוֹת. דְּפָנוֹת סָלְקָא דַּעְתָּךְ? אֶלָּא: שֶׁעַל גַּבֵּי דּוֹפְנֵי רֵיאָה.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «Which» blood vessel «is the aorta? Rabba bar Yitzḥak says» that «Rav says:» This is the artery found in the «fat on the sides.» The Gemara asks: Can it «enter your mind» to say that this is referring to the «sides» of the animal, i.e., the ribs, which are not adjacent to the heart? «Rather,» this is referring to the artery covered in fat «that» exits the heart and passes «on the sides of the lung.»

segments.he: אָמַר אַמֵּימָר מִשְּׁמֵיהּ דְּרַב נַחְמָן: תְּלָתָא קְנֵי הָווּ, חַד פָּרֵישׁ לְלִיבָּא, וְחַד פָּרֵישׁ לְרֵיאָה, וְחַד פָּרֵישׁ לְכַבְדָּא. דְּרֵיאָה – כְּרֵיאָה, דְּכַבְדָּא – כְּכַבְדָּא, דְּלִיבָּא – פְּלִיגִי.
segments.en: «Ameimar says in the name of Rav Naḥman: There are three ducts» adjacent to one another in an animal’s chest. «One separates to the heart, and one separates to the lung, and one separates to the liver.» The duct «of the lung» is treated «like the lung,» and renders the animal a tereifa if perforated in any amount. The duct «of the liver» is treated «like the liver,» and only if it is completely missing does it render the animal a tereifa, in accordance with the mishna. As for the duct «of the heart,» the aorta, Rav and Shmuel «disagree» as to the measure of its perforation, as mentioned above.

segments.he: מָר בַּר חִיָּיא מַתְנִי אִיפְּכָא: דְּרֵיאָה – כְּכַבְדָּא, דְּכַבְדָּא – כְּרֵיאָה, דְּלִיבָּא – פְּלִיגִי.
segments.en: «Mar bar Ḥiyya teaches the opposite:» The duct «of the lung» is treated «like the liver» and renders the animal a tereifa only if it is completely missing. The duct «of the liver» is treated «like the lung,» and a perforation of any amount renders the animal a tereifa. And with regard to the duct «of the heart,» Rav and Shmuel «disagree.»

segments.he: אֲזַל רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר יוֹסֵף אַמְרַהּ לִשְׁמַעְתָּא דְרַב קַמֵּיהּ דִּשְׁמוּאֵל, אֲמַר לֵיהּ: אִי הָכִי אָמַר אַבָּא – לָא יָדַע בִּטְרֵפוֹת וְלֹא כְּלוּם.
segments.en: The Gemara relates that «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Yosef went and stated the halakha of Rav,» that an aorta perforated in any amount renders an animal a tereifa, «before Shmuel.» Shmuel «said to him: If Abba,» i.e., Rav, actually «said so, he knows nothing at all about tereifot.»
